name: CoseToKey
description: Converts a COSE key (struct with integer keys per RFC 9052, or raw CBOR bytes) to a Java security key. Returns a PublicKey when only public material is present, or a key pair struct (with 'public' and 'private' keys) when both are present. Supports EC (P-256, P-384, P-521) and Ed25519 keys.

params.name: coseKey
params.description: COSE key as a struct (from CborDecode) or raw CBOR-encoded binary
